title: HolyThingSyncResponse
description: Response schema returned by the HolyThing Google Apps Script Web App endpoint (doGet).

upToDate.description: True when the client-supplied ?since=<version> matches the current backend data version.

version.description: The current version hash confirming client is up to date.
Deterministic SHA-256 hash fingerprint of active cards.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this feed was generated.

count.description: Total count of active cards included in the payload.

id.description: Unique identifier for the card (e.g. card_001).

format.description: The card layout and visual structure archetype.

hook.description: Attention hook line displayed first in large typography.

verse_text.description: Full verse text cleaned of linebreaks and stray characters.

translation.description: Bible translation identifier (e.g. WEB, KJV, BSB).

insight.description: Short plain-language insight or historical/spiritual context.

topics.description: List of normalized lower-case topical keywords.

moods.description: Emotional and mental state descriptors (e.g. anxious, tired, hopeful).

tone.description: Tone classification (e.g. comforting, inspiring, historical, reflective).

book.description: Book of the Bible (e.g. Psalms, Romans, Matthew).

length.description: Reading length classification to help pace the user's feed.

series_id.description: Identifies multi-part narrative series (required for 'story' cards).

series_order.description: 1-based order within the series (required for 'story' cards).

reflection_prompt.description: Guilt-free prompt inviting the reader to pause, breathe, or pray.
